grade: Crianças bem pequenas (1 ano e 7 meses a 3 anos e 11 meses)
subject: Espaços, Tempos, Quantidades, Relações e Transformações
description_pt: Contar oralmente objetos, pessoas, livros etc., em contextos diversos.

components.description_pt: Usar palavras de contagem precisas para afirmar o número exato de objetos em um conjunto
components.description_en: Use precise counting words to state the exact number of objects in a set
components.cc_component_description: Use precise counting words to state the exact number of objects in a set

components.description_pt: Dado um número de 1 a 20, contar essa quantidade de objetos
components.description_en: Given a number from 1-20, count out that many objects
components.cc_component_description: Given a number from 1-20, count out that many objects

components.description_pt: Ao contar objetos, saber que o último número dito indica a quantidade de objetos contados
components.description_en: When counting objects, know that the last number name said tells the number of objects counted
components.cc_component_description: When counting objects, know that the last number name said tells the number of objects counted

cc_matches.description: Understand that the last number name said tells the number of objects counted. The number of objects is the same regardless of their arrangement or the order in which they were counted.

Count to answer "how many?" questions about as many as 20 things arranged in a line, a rectangular array, or a circle, or as many as 10 things in a scattered configuration; given a number from 1—20, count out that many objects.
